SEARCH
Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.fact

Annotation Interface ResourceFact

@Target({TYPE,METHOD}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Repeatable(ResourceFacts.class) public @interface ResourceFact
Declares a deterministic domain fact or computed indicator published by a Praxis resource in /schemas/domain and inspectable by both the business rules track (decisionKind = BUSINESS via praxis-rules-engine) and the authorization track (decisionKind = AUTHORIZATION via praxis-authz-*).

Catalog discovery is strictly reflective and never invokes the annotated method. When declared on a controller annotated with ApiResource or on its resolved ResponseDTO, resourceKey() inherits @ApiResource.resourceKey() automatically when omitted. Every declared fact must make its authority, evaluation phase, missing-value behavior, and scope explicit so that static reviewers (SemanticMetadataReviewer) and downstream policy compilers can reject unverified or client-overridable inputs in fail-closed flows.

Because Java annotation members accept compile-time constants, use the canonical lowercase wire strings or the WIRE_* constants exposed on ResourceFactDataType, ResourceFactSourceKind, ResourceFactAuthority, ResourceFactEvaluationPhase, ResourceFactMissingValuePolicy, and ResourceFactScope:


 @ResourceFact(
     key = "activeAssignmentsCount",
     label = "Vínculos ativos",
     description = "Quantidade de vínculos funcionais ativos sob o titular.",
     dataType = "integer",
     sourceKind = "computed",
     icon = "badge",
     tone = "info",
     authority = "server_computed",
     evaluationPhase = "post_read",
     missingValuePolicy = "fail_closed",
     scope = "item"
 )

    Optional Element

    • sourceKind

    • authority

      String authority
      Authoritative origin of the fact value matching ResourceFactAuthority. Must be one of "server_computed", "persisted_state", "authenticated_context", or "governed_grant" as enforced by ResourceFactDescriptor; raw client inputs and unknown authorities are rejected fail-closed.
      Default:
      "server_computed"

      Lifecycle phase in which the fact is available matching ResourceFactEvaluationPhase ("pre_authorize", "post_read", "pre_write", "post_write", or "query_projection").
      Default:
      "post_read"

    • scope

      String scope
      Cardinality scope of the fact matching ResourceFactScope ("item", "collection", "tenant", or "principal").
